display.label: AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS)
display.description: Provision Amazon EKS Kubernetes clusters with managed node groups, OIDC IRSA, and cluster addons

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique identifier for the EKS Cluster, applied as the resource name and map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Cluster name, Kubernetes version, and control plane settings.

fields.label: Cluster Name
fields.description: Unique name for the EKS cluster (up to 100 alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores).

validation.pattern_error: Name must be 1-100 characters, start with an alphanumeric character, and contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

fields.label: Kubernetes Version
fields.description: Desired Kubernetes version for the EKS control plane.

fields.label: Authentication Mode
fields.description: The authentication mode for the cluster API server.

fields.label: Bootstrap Creator as Cluster Admin
fields.description: Automatically grant the IAM principal deploying the cluster administrative permissions via an EKS Access Entry.

sections.label: Networking & VPC
sections.description: VPC, subnets, and endpoint access controls.

fields.label: VPC
fields.description: The VPC where the cluster control plane and worker nodes reside.

fields.label: Subnets
fields.description: List of at least two subnets across different Availability Zones for the control plane and nodes.

fields.label: Enable Private Endpoint
fields.description: Enable private API server access within the VPC.

fields.label: Enable Public Endpoint
fields.description: Enable public Internet access to the Kubernetes API server.

fields.label: Create Dedicated Security Group
fields.description: Create a dedicated Security Group for the EKS Cluster control plane.

sections.label: IAM & Identity
sections.description: IAM roles and OIDC identity provider for IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA).

fields.label: Create Cluster IAM Role
fields.description: Automatically provision an IAM role with required AmazonEKSClusterPolicy permissions.

fields.label: Create OIDC Provider (IRSA)
fields.description: Enable IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA) via an IAM OpenID Connect identity provider.

fields.label: Create Node IAM Role
fields.description: Automatically create an IAM role for worker node groups with standard node policies.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: User-defined key-value tags to assign to the EKS Cluster.
